title: NUnit process check uses a missing working directory
root_cause: The workflow supplies audit/catalogs as the child process working directory, while the checkout contains audit/catalog. Process.Start cannot enter the requested directory and NUnit reports the test as failed.

relevant_evidence.why: The test output reports an invalid working directory.
The workflow supplies the plural directory.
The test uses that value as the process working directory.
The existing catalog directory is singular.
